status: Setting up. The 4k-16k pool (contradiction, outlier, reorder, qdmatch_nq) and its held-out probe rows are being built. Seven idea agents are implementing in parallel; Lambda and Beaker are being staged as extra run capacity. No 16k result yet: the pilot table at the bottom is the earlier 8k run on the old task set.
setup: Each method trains with its own forward, optimiser and real LR schedule on the same first batches of the pool (16 rows/step, 2 GPUs).
At fixed steps the dense forward (full context, no dropping, adapters on) is scored on held-out rows: teacher-forced answer CE, 16 rows per task and length (4k, 8k, 16k), eval_size 192.

Score = training FLOPs the dense reference needs to reach a loss level divided by the FLOPs the method needs to reach the same level, on the mean loss and on the worst task. Peak GPU memory is logged per step.
One iteration is under 15 minutes. Every 2-3 hours the most promising methods get a larger FLOP-matched training run with generation-graded evals.

log.text: Seven idea agents started (no-grad prefix + early cuts, gold-aware stochastic keep, early-layer loss selection, detached context, FLOP-aware row sampling, FFN skip for context tokens, token-drop CPT base search). Staging agents started for Lambda and Beaker.
